description: Goal-conditioned line C45 (user decisions 2026-10-01): five groups 1:1:1:1:1 by steps. Emptied-room navigation over the 1x1 and the other-shape rooms together (8 goals; 8 s per goal, 15 s in rooms beyond 1x1), combat then navigation (1x1, 4 goals), the real-floor chain, Basement I boss rooms, and single-room COMBAT over the 1x1 and the other-shape normal rooms. Start: bombs from the run (--start-bombs 0.5:3); half hearts 1 with probability 0.5 else uniform 1-6 in the navigation group (a bomb of its own kills), uniform 1-6 elsewhere. Training rooms exclude the GOTO held-out rooms; GOTO evaluations on them, the chain on all 491 1x1 rooms, the single-room COMBAT on all 849 normal rooms, the boss group on its 82 rooms (validation seeds).
